name: Shinagawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shinagawa ward emblem in white: an outlined three-armed device of interlocking strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shinagawa, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 October 1952.

features.role: Shinagawa ward emblem — an outlined three-armed device of interlocking strokes, like a stylised character
